survey.title: A quick space quiz
survey.description: Check each answer to learn why. Skip anything you don't know.

elements.name: red_planet
elements.title: Which planet is commonly called the Red Planet?

elements.name: terrestrial
elements.title: Which of these are terrestrial planets? Select all that apply.

red_planet.explanation: Mars is called the Red Planet because iron oxides in its surface dust give it a reddish appearance.

choiceExplanations.mars: Mars has reddish iron-oxide-rich dust, which is the origin of this nickname.
choiceExplanations.venus: Venus is covered by bright clouds and is not known as the Red Planet. The nickname refers to Mars's reddish surface dust.
choiceExplanations.jupiter: Jupiter has coloured cloud bands, but the nickname Red Planet refers to Mars, not to Jupiter's Great Red Spot.

terrestrial.explanation: Earth and Mars are rocky terrestrial planets with solid surfaces. Jupiter is a gas giant, so it does not belong in this group.

choiceExplanations.earth: Earth has a rocky composition and a solid surface, making it a terrestrial planet.
choiceExplanations.mars: Mars also has a rocky composition and solid surface, so both Earth and Mars must be selected.
choiceExplanations.jupiter: Jupiter is a gas giant dominated by hydrogen and helium, not a rocky terrestrial planet.
